analysis: Built paired real Wasm AVC decoders with identical compiler/link settings; candidate removes CABAC execution behind progressive8bit420/CAVLC guards. Both decode all30 full frames and PTS exactly; an in-owner CABAC PPS change passes the ordinary decoder but candidate returns explicit rejection before publishing any changed-profile picture. Wasm bytes fall only0.4522%. Seven alternating fresh-browser load/start/decode jobs have median1.5326x candidate cost and very wide0.213–7.700x ratios under concurrent campaign load. No trustworthy gain demonstrated; retain inconclusive cost outcome, not a stable53% regression claim. Initial control incorrectly flushed the decoder before testing a tool change; preserved and corrected to a live unflushed owner, without changing profile acceptance. No production routing change, physical hardware claim or general stream qualification.
